selection.decision: Neural models and full baselines frozen before test loading; the additional same-feature XGB baseline was fixed before reading test results

primary_neural.prediction: equal-weight arithmetic mean of probabilities from three fits

secondary_neural.prediction: equal-weight arithmetic mean of probabilities from three fits; each fit has 16 shared-weight members

additional_paired_baseline.reason: Best feature-family XGB validation ensemble (AUC 0.9083449283); exactly the same std/energy inputs as selected TREA

selection.test_use: Evaluate frozen fits once; no test-driven tuning, reselection, or split changes
selection.threshold: Maximize macro-F1 using internal validation probabilities only; freeze separately for each fit and ensemble
selection.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap of entire groups, 500 replicates; seed variation is reported separately
selection.fair_comparison: Contemporaneous models on identical reserved groups; historical bar is not a paired test baseline
